title: Tiny, cute lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M38 28 Q50 14 62 28' fill='none' stroke='#FFB84D' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- top cap -->
  <rect x='33' y='27' width='34' height='8' rx='3' fill='#E8A030'/>
  <rect x='36' y='29' width='28' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FFD884'/>
  <!-- glass body -->
  <rect x='30' y='35' width='40' height='40' rx='8' fill='#7A5A2A'/>
  <!-- inner glow -->
  <rect x='35' y='40' width='30' height='30' rx='6' fill='#FFE680'/>
  <!-- flame -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#FF9A1F'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='4.5' ry='7' fill='#FFD84D'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#FFF6C4'/>
  <!-- flame highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='57' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#FFEFB0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- glass shine -->
  <rect x='36' y='42' width='5' height='20' rx='2.5' fill='#FFEFB0' opacity='0.45'/>
  <!-- base -->
  <rect x='30' y='75' width='40' height='8' rx='3' fill='#E8A030'/>
  <rect x='33' y='77' width='34' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FFD884'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <rect x='34' y='83' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#C88A20'/>
  <rect x='59' y='83' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#C88A20'/>
  <!-- cheeks on glass (cute) -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='55' r='3' fill='#FFAA66' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='55' r='3' fill='#FFAA66' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- cute face -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='50' r='2.2' fill='#7A4A10'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='50' r='2.2' fill='#7A4A10'/>
  <path d='M47 54 Q50 57 53 54' fill='none' stroke='#7A4A10' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
